usageNotes: Use this to update an existing prepared auto-installer answer configuration by its ID — for example, to change network settings, disk selection, root credentials, or target-filter rules after the config was initially created. The operation is synchronous and returns the updated config object immediately (no task UPID). Requires `System.Modify` on the `system/auto-installation` path; pass the `digest` field from a prior GET to guard against concurrent edits overwriting each other.

examples.summary: Update a prepared config to use static networking and pin a specific disk

tips: Only one config can have `is-default: true`; setting it on this record clears the flag from whichever config previously held it.
Fields with MiniJinja template support (cidr, gateway, dns, fqdn, mailto) are validated at render time, not at save time — invalid templates will not be caught here.
Use the `delete` array to remove optional fields (e.g., `["target-filter"]`) rather than sending a null value.
If `authorized-tokens` is set, only those PDM API token IDs can fetch this answer during installation; omit the field to allow any authenticated requester.
The `target-filter` field uses RFC6901 JSON Pointers as keys and glob patterns as values; it is ignored when `is-default` is true.
Setting `root-password-hashed` is preferred over `root-password` for security — the plaintext password is stored in the config on disk.
